answer: The oblique saggital view permits the evaluation of distinctly buccal and lingual cortical bone margins, as well as clear visualization of the internal structure such as incisive and inferior alveolar canals. The commercially available desktop interactive software permits the clinician to view the radiographic studies in two or three dimensions, make direct measurements, assess bone volumes and density, manipulate the images to simulate implant placement or bone grafting procedures, and simultaneously view the images in all the three planes
